findings.title: Lack of check on pool TVL after adding liquidity
findings.description:
In the ft_on_transfer() function, when handling a HotZap message, liquidity can be added to the Degen Pool without verifying whether the total value locked (TVL) exceeds a predefined limit. 
The vulnerability arises from missing validation logic after liquidity is added. 
An attacker could exploit this by repeatedly injecting liquidity to push the TVL beyond safe thresholds. 
The impact is that the Degen Pool’s TVL may exceed its intended limit, potentially destabilizing the economic model or increasing exposure to market risks.

findings.title: Lack of TVL price valid check
findings.description:
The view function get_degen_pool_tvl() calculates the TVL of the Degen Pool using token prices but does not validate whether the price data is current or valid. 
This is due to the absence of a check against price staleness or oracle health. 
While not directly exploitable for fund theft, an attacker could manipulate or rely on stale prices in front-running scenarios or misleading UIs. 
The impact is that users may observe outdated or incorrect TVL values, leading to poor decision-making based on inaccurate data.
